title.narrative: INnovative SOcial Protection System for inclusiON of Vulnerable People Project

description.narrative: The development objective of the Innovative Social Protection System for Inclusion of Vulnerable People Project for Uzbekistan is to improve access to and quality of social services and benefits for vulnerable people in Uzbekistan. The project comprises of four components. The first component, strengthening the integration and shock responsiveness of the social protection system objective is to improve the inclusion and resilience of the poor and vulnerable people through INSON centers improved capacity to assess needs, coordinate emergency support, and integrate the provision of social benefits and services. It consists of following sub-components: (i) supporting the development of a case management system for beneficiaries of social protection services and benefits; and (ii) enhancing the capacity of the social protection system to adapt and respond to shocks. The second component, improving the access and quality of social services for vulnerable people objective is to: (a) improve the quality of social services for vulnerable children and adults by developing minimum quality and cost standards for social services, setting up a coordinated governance for multisectoral services for survivors of gender-based violence (GBV), and transforming specialized vocational education and training (VET) schools for students with disabilities into resource hubs for inclusive education, and (b) expand the access to social services for vulnerable people, including those who are vulnerable to climate change-exacerbated floods, drought, and extreme heat by piloting and gradually scaling up community-based Territorial Social Service Center (TSSCs). It consists of following sub-components: (i) improving the quality of social services for vulnerable people, including survivors of GBV; (ii) expanding access to social services through the establishment and operation of TSSCs; and (iii) transforming specialized VET schools for secondary students with disabilities into resource hubs and activation centers. The third component, project management and monitoring and evaluation (M and E) will support the day-to-day management of project implementation, the M and E of its objectives and outcomes, and the capacity of the National Agency for Social Protection of the Republic of Uzbekistan (NASP). It consists of following sub-components: (i) project management; and (ii) strengthening the M and E capacity for evidence-based policy making. The fourth component, contingent emergency response component (CERC) aims at providing rapid access to noncommitted resources of the project to support response to an eligible crisis or emergency, including natural disaster and climate change driven events, as needed.
